1. Local Network System Architecture

The SaNDS Lab Smart Parking Management System runs completely on-premises inside your local hospital/building network subnet (e.g. 192.168.8.x or 192.168.1.x). It does not require continuous internet access for local barrier control, plate recognition, or cashier operations.

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ LOCAL HOSPITAL / FACILITY LAN SUBNET │ │ │ │ ┌──────────────────────────┐ ┌──────────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ UNV / Dahua / Hik │ │ Central Local Parking Server │ │ │ │ ANPR Cameras │ Push VIID / HTTP │ Host IP: 192.168.8.11 │ │ │ │ IP: 192.168.8.200 ├──────────────────►│ ├── PHP API Backend (8081) │ │ │ │ IP: 192.168.8.201 │ │ ├── Web Dashboard UI (5173) │ │ │ └─────────────┬────────────┘ │ ├── MediaMTX Stream (8889) │ │ │ │ │ └── MySQL Database (3306) │ │ │ │ RTSP Live Stream └──────────────┬───────────────────┘ │ │ └───────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ │ ▼ │ │ ┌──────────────────────────┐ ┌──────────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ Barrier Relay Gates │◄──────────────────┤ Operator / Cashier Terminals │ │ │ │ Relay IP: 192.168.1.201│ Pulse TCP 8080 │ http://192.168.8.11:5173 │ │ │ └──────────────────────────┘ └──────────────────────────────────┘ │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
PHP Backend Server
Port 8081

REST API, ANPR Camera Push Receiver (/VIID/MotorVehicles, /api/v1/webhook/anpr), Display Board backend.

Frontend Web Portal
Port 5173

React Operator Portal, Live Gate Monitor, Visitor QR Validation, Reports, and System Settings.

Live RTSP Stream Bridge
Port 8889

MediaMTX ultra-low latency WebRTC/HLS live video stream gateway for IP camera streams.

2. Server Prerequisites & Requirements

Component Requirement Purpose
Operating System Windows 10 / 11 / Windows Server 2019+ (or Ubuntu 20.04+) Host machine for running services
PHP PHP 8.1 or higher with pdo_mysql, curl, mbstring, openssl, fileinfo Powers backend API & camera webhook handler
MySQL Server MySQL 8.0 or MariaDB 10.6+ Stores parking sessions, tariffs, settings, and logs
Node.js & npm Node.js 18.x or 20.x Runs or compiles the React Web Portal
Network Static IPv4 on Local LAN (e.g. 192.168.8.11) Allows ANPR cameras and cashier PCs to reach the server

3. Quick 1-Click Startup (Windows)

On Windows, you can start the entire parking system in a single unified console window using the pre-configured launcher:

1
Open the Root Project Directory
Navigate to E:\parkingsolution\ (or your project folder).
2
Double-Click START_PARKING_SYSTEM.bat
The script will detect your LAN IP, check MySQL, start the Stream Bridge (8889), PHP Backend (8081), Frontend Web Portal (5173), and open your browser automatically.
3
Log In to the Web Management Portal
URL: http://localhost:5173 | Admin: admin / admin123 | Superadmin: superadmin / admin123
Single Console Controller: The launcher window stays open with an interactive menu. You can press 1 for Dashboard, 2 for Display Board, 3 for Camera Logs, 4 to Restart, or Q to cleanly terminate all background services.

4. Manual Step-by-Step Installation (Local Server)

Step 1: Database Setup

Create the database and import the initial schema and seeds:

# Open MySQL Terminal or phpMyAdmin:
CREATE DATABASE parking_db CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

# Import Schema and Initial Seeds:
mysql -u root -p parking_db < backend/database/schema.sql
mysql -u root -p parking_db < backend/database/seed.sql

Step 2: Backend Configuration

Configure database credentials in backend/config/database.php:

<?php
return [
    'host'     => '127.0.0.1',
    'port'     => 3306,
    'database' => 'parking_db',
    'username' => 'root',
    'password' => 'YOUR_MYSQL_PASSWORD',
    'charset'  => 'utf8mb4'
];

Step 3: Start PHP Backend Server

# From the project root folder:
php -S 0.0.0.0:8081 backend/public/index.php

Step 4: Start Frontend Web Portal

# From the frontend folder:
cd frontend
npm install
npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173

Step 5: Start Live RTSP Stream Bridge (Optional for Camera Video)

# From the tools/mediamtx folder:
cd tools/mediamtx
mediamtx.exe mediamtx.yml

5. Configuring ANPR Cameras to Push to Local Server

Set all your ANPR Cameras (Uniview, Dahua, Hikvision) on the same LAN subnet to push plate events into your server IP:

Camera Brand Protocol Server IP Setting Server Port Push Path / URL
Uniview (UNV) Photo Server 1 / VIID 192.168.8.11 (Your Server IP) 8081 /VIID/MotorVehicles
Dahua ANPR HTTP Post / Webhook 192.168.8.11 (Your Server IP) 8081 /api/v1/webhook/anpr
Hikvision LPR HTTP Listening / Alarm Host 192.168.8.11 (Your Server IP) 8081 /api/v1/webhook/anpr
Tip: You can check incoming camera events live in backend/storage/logs/anpr_incoming.log or on the Live Gate Monitor page (/lanes).

6. Accessing the System from Other PCs on the LAN

Any cashier, security guard, or admin workstation connected to the same hospital or facility WiFi / Ethernet network can access the portal directly using the server's IP address:

🖥️ Cashier & Gate Operator Terminal:
http://192.168.8.11:5173
Dashboard, Live Gate Monitor, Cashier Checkout, Reports.
📺 LED Parking Display Board App:
http://192.168.8.11:5173/display
Floor-wise available slots counter and welcome banner for drivers.
Windows Firewall Setup: If other PCs cannot connect, open Windows Defender Firewall > Advanced Settings > Inbound Rules and create an Inbound Rule allowing TCP Ports 8081, 5173, and 8889.

7. Configuring Auto-Start on Windows Boot

To ensure the parking system starts automatically whenever the server computer boots or restarts:

  1. Press Win + R, type shell:startup, and press Enter to open the Windows Startup folder.
  2. Right-click inside the folder > New > Shortcut.
  3. Browse and select E:\parkingsolution\START_PARKING_SYSTEM.bat.
  4. Name the shortcut SaNDS Parking System Auto-Start and click Finish.
